autohud.option.dynamicOnLoad.zh: 在游戏加载时启用动态 HUD

autohud.option.dynamicOnLoad.description.en: Enable dynamic HUD on game load

autohud.option.ticksRevealed.description.en: The time in ticks that components should be revealed for. After this time, they automatically hide again.

autohud.option.animationMove.description.en: Enables the move animation, hiding components by pushing them off the screen.

autohud.option.animationFade.description.en: Enables the fade animation, hiding components by reducing their opacity.

autohud.group.animationSpeeds.zh: Special animation speeds (set to 0 to use above value)

autohud.group.animationSpeeds.descriptio.en: Special animation speeds Set to 0 to use above value

autohud.option.animationSpeeds.moveIn.de.en: Animation speed while moving in. Set to 0 to use above speed value.

autohud.option.animationSpeeds.moveOut.d.en: Animation speed while moving out. Set to 0 to use above speed value.

autohud.option.animationSpeeds.fadeIn.de.en: Animation speed while fading in. Set to 0 to use above speed value.

autohud.option.animationSpeeds.fadeOut.d.en: Animation speed while fading out. Set to 0 to use above speed value.

autohud.option.revealType.description.en:
Handle the components as such:
Individual: move all components individually
Stacked: Hide components only if not blocked by other visible components
Grouped: move all logically grouped components (hotbar area) together
Hide Combined: hide revealed components together
Combined: move all components together

autohud.option.health.policy.zh: 在如下条件下显示生命值

autohud.option.health.policy.description.en:
Always: always visible
Disabled: do not automatically reveal
Changing: reveal when health changes
Increasing: reveal when healing
Decreasing: reveal when hurting
Not Full: reveal when not at full health
Low: reveal when at low health

autohud.option.hunger.policy.zh: 在如下条件下显示饥饿值

autohud.option.hunger.policy.description.en:
Always: always visible
Disabled: do not automatically reveal
Changing: reveal when hunger changes
Increasing: reveal when eating
Decreasing: reveal when gaining hunger
Not Full: reveal when not at full food bar
Low: reveal when at low food bar

autohud.option.air.policy.zh: 在如下条件下显示氧气值

autohud.option.air.policy.description.en:
Always: always visible
Disabled: do not automatically reveal
Changing: reveal when air changes
Increasing: reveal when gaining air
Decreasing: reveal when losing air
Not Full: reveal when not at full health
Low: reveal when at low health

autohud.option.armor.policy.zh: 在如下条件下显示盔甲

autohud.option.armor.policy.description.en:
Always: always visible
Disabled: do not automatically reveal
Changing: reveal when armor changes
Increasing: reveal when adding armor
Decreasing: reveal when removing armor
Not Full: reveal when not at full armor bar
Low: reveal when armor bar is low

autohud.option.experience.active.descrip.en: Dynamically hide the experience bar. If disabled, the experience bar is always visible.

autohud.option.experience.onChange.descr.en: Reveal the experience bar whenever gaining experience.

autohud.option.mountJumpBar.active.zh: 不蓄力时隐藏坐骑跳跃栏

autohud.option.mountJumpBar.active.descr.en: Hide mount jump bar when not charging

autohud.option.mountJumpBar.onChange.zh: 蓄力时显示坐骑跳跃栏

autohud.option.mountJumpBar.onChange.des.en: Reveal mount jump bar during charge

autohud.option.mountHealth.policy.zh: 在如下条件下显示坐骑健康状况

autohud.option.mountHealth.policy.descri.en:
Always: always visible
Disabled: do not automatically reveal
Changing: reveal when health changes
Increasing: reveal when healing
Decreasing: reveal when hurting
Not Full: reveal when not at full health
Low: reveal when at low health

autohud.option.hotbar.hotbar.onChange.zh: 在活动栏的内容变化时显示

autohud.option.hotbar.hotbar.onChange.de.en: Reveal whenever the active slot's content changes

autohud.option.hotbar.onSlotChange.zh: 在切换选择存储槽时显示

autohud.option.hotbar.onSlotChange.descr.en: Reveal when switching the currently selected slot

autohud.option.hotbar.maximumFadeHotbarI.en: Fade-out limit for hotbar items. Set this to non-zero to keep the contents of the hotbar always slightly visible.

autohud.option.statusEffectTimer.zh: 在其图标上显示状态效果的剩余时间

autohud.option.statusEffectTimer.descrip.en: Show remaining time of status effects on their icon

autohud.option.hidePersistentStatusEffec.en: Always hide the status effect symbol for unchanging status effects, such as when wearing a turtle master helmet

autohud.option.scoreboard.scoreboard.onC.en: Reveal when the scoreboard title changes

autohud.option.scoreboard.onTeamChange.d.en: If the team is part of the player score, update it; otherwise any team can update and still provide no actual visibility

autohud.option.crosshair.active.descript.en: Hide the crosshair. By default in "fade" mode, it is only made mostly transparent. Go to advanced settings to configure this.

autohud.option.crosshair.onChange.descri.en: Reveal when any block or entity is targeted. If DynamicCrosshair is installed, that mod's settings are used.

autohud.option.defaultValues.speedMultip.en: Speed multiplier that gets added onto the animation speed.

autohud.option.defaultValues.distance.de.en: Controls how many pixels elements move out by

autohud.option.defaultValues.maximumFade.en: Controls how far the opacity of elements can be reduced.

autohud.option.advanced.label.en:
Here you can manually adjust values for each component. This might be necessary if some other mod moves components around.
Set numeric values to -1 to inherit from default.
autohud.option.advanced.label.zh:
Here you can manually adjust values for each component. This might be necessary if some other mod moves components around.
Set numeric values to -1 to inherit from default.

autohud.option.advanced.direction.descri.en: Which direction to move the component in. You probably want to set it to its closest screen edge.

autohud.option.advanced.speedMultiplier..en: Speed multiplier that gets added onto the animation speed. Set to -1 to use default.

autohud.option.advanced.distance.descrip.en: Controls how many pixels this element moves out by. Set to -1 to use default.

autohud.option.advanced.maximumFade.desc.en: Controls how far the opacity of this element can be reduced. Set to -1 to use default.

modmenu.descriptionTranslation.autohud.en: Dynamic HUD that hides interface elements while they are not needed.
modmenu.descriptionTranslation.autohud.zh: 动态 HUD，在不需要时隐藏界面元素。

autohud.option.revealType.@Tooltip.zh:
独立：独立移动所有部件
叠加：只有在不被其他可见组件阻挡的情况下才会隐藏组件
分组：将所有逻辑上分组的组件（快捷栏区）移到一起
隐藏合并：将显示的组件一起隐藏
合并：将所有组件一起移动

autohud.option.hidePersistentStatusEffec.zh: 对于不变的状态效果总是隐藏状态效果符号，例如戴着海龟壳时。

autohud.option.statusEffectTimer.@Toolti.zh: Show remaining time of status effects on their icon

autohud.option.scoreboard.onTeamChange.@.zh: 如果队伍是玩家分数的一部分，则更新它；否则，任何队伍都可以更新，但仍然没有提供实际的可见性。

autohud.requireYaclForConfigScreen.zh: To configure AutoHUD through ModMenu, please install YetAnotherConfigLib!
